sources.title: Chatterbox Nano: Lightweight Edge TTS Model | Resemble AI
sources.snippet: Chatterbox Nano runs at 10x realtime on GPU and 3x on CPU at just 110M parameters. Voice cloning, paralinguistic tags, watermarking by default. Open source TTS for the edge from Resemble AI.
